G1_unambiguity.justification: The geometric condition is precise and, given the allowed values, clearly determines which pairs of sequence elements may differ.

G2_completeness.justification: It specifies the sequence domain, all input bounds and formats, the validity condition, lexicographic ordering, output format, and impossibility case.

G3_faithfulness.justification: For values in {1,2,3}, the three parabola points with (4,16) are non-collinear exactly when c_u and c_v differ, so the rewritten task is equivalent to proper three-coloring with the same lexicographic tie-break.

G4_naturalness.justification: The prose is clear and idiomatic, though replacing the straightforward conflict interpretation with an artificial geometric construction makes the problem feel somewhat contrived.
